meta.name: bash-defensive-patterns
meta.description: Master defensive Bash programming techniques for production-grade scripts. Use when writing robust shell scripts, CI/CD pipelines, or system utilities requiring fault tolerance and safety.

copy.tagline: 学会编写健壮安全的 Bash 脚本
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你经常编写或维护 Bash 脚本,希望它们更健壮可靠。
copy.tagline_en: Master defensive Bash patterns to build robust shell scripts.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you write Bash scripts that need to be robust and safe in production.

howto.what: 当 Claude 编写 Bash 脚本时,会按此技能套用防御式编程:开启严格模式(set -Eeuo pipefail)、给变量加引号、设置错误捕获与清理、验证输入参数、支持 dry-run 等。
howto.when: 当用户要求编写健壮的 Shell 脚本、CI/CD 流水线或系统工具等需要容错与安全的场景时。

say.text: 帮我写个生产级 bash 脚本,要开启严格模式并处理错误。
给这个 CI/CD 脚本加上参数校验和日志功能。
say.note: 会添加参数解析和带时间戳的日志函数。

say.text: 写一个幂等的部署脚本,支持 dry-run 预览。
say.note: 会设计成可重复运行,并提供 DRY_RUN 开关。

howto.what_en: After installation, when Claude writes Bash scripts, it applies defensive patterns: strict mode, quoted variables, error trapping, input validation, dry-run support, etc.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks for robust shell scripts, CI/CD pipelines, or system utilities that need fault tolerance and safety.

say_en.text: Write a production-grade bash script with strict mode and error handling.
say_en.note: Generates a script with set -Eeuo pipefail and trap.

say_en.text: Add argument validation and logging to this CI/CD script.
say_en.note: Adds argument parsing and timestamped log functions.

say_en.text: Write an idempotent deployment script with dry-run support.
say_en.note: Designed to rerun safely with a DRY_RUN flag.
